What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain the Flutter macOS app with clean architecture, modular layers, and reliable state management .
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and real-time services (e.g., WebSockets/Streams ).
  • Implement A/V features (e.g., flutter_webrtc): device selection, camera/mic permissions, I/O routing, and stability under variable networks.
  • Ensure observability end to end: instrument product events/metrics; triage errors with Sentry ; capture UX signals with Microsoft Clarity (session replay/heatmaps) where applicable (web/embedded views); analyze performance traces and dashboards.
  • Own quality : unit, widget, and integration tests; CI checks; code reviews; technical docs.
  • Handle macOS distribution : code signing & notarization , entitlements, Hardened Runtime , App Sandbox , Keychain; package DMG/PKG ; manage auto-update (e.g., Sparkle).
  • Collaborate with Product/Design/QA to refine requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria; keep specs tidy in Confluence and PRs clear.
  • Team rituals & reporting:
  • Attend daily standups in English and other ceremonies (planning, grooming, demos, retros).
  • Keep Jira up to date (status, links, attachments) and log time entries (work logs) per task.
  • Submit an end-of-day (EOD) daily report in English including: hours worked (per task), what was completed, current task & ETA, blockers, and plan for tomorrow.
  • Secondary (Android & iOS): maintain parity when applicable, fix platform-specific issues, help with CI/CD and store releases , monitor crashes/perf via Sentry and review UX insights with Clarity when relevant.


CPU & GPU Optimizations (primary focus)

CPU

  • Minimize rebuilds: effective state selection (BLoC/Riverpod/Provider), const constructors, proper Keys , split large widgets.
  • Cut redundant layout/work: avoid heavy logic in build, cache computed values, reduce intrinsic measurements, coalesce events, debounce/throttle streams.
  • Move heavy tasks off the UI thread: isolates (compute/custom), lazy JSON parsing, incremental work units.
  • Frame scheduling discipline: prevent setState loops; render only when state actually changes.

GPU

  • Reduce overdraw/repaints : place RepaintBoundary wisely; optimize CustomPainter (shouldRepaint); avoid large Opacity on complex subtrees.
  • Avoid expensive effects: minimize saveLayer , heavy blurs/gradients and big shadows .
  • Use right-sized images & filterQuality (low/none when acceptable); limit transforms on large layers.
  • Shader jank control: warm up shaders / capture SkSL where applicable; keep fragment shaders simple.
  • Pause/disable animations when off-screen; keep animation count/area minimal.


Measurement & Guardrails:

  • Profile with Flutter DevTools (CPU/GPU/frame timeline) and add perf budgets (avg CPU%/GPU frame time) to CI gates.
  • Track before/after metrics per feature; regressions must be fixed before release.


Must-Haves

  • Fluent English (spoken and written): comfortable in daily English standups and writing EOD reports.
  • Strong experience with Flutter and Dart building Desktop apps (preferably macOS ).
  • Proven work reducing CPU/GPU usage in Flutter apps (ideally desktop/macOS) with measurable before/after results.
  • Solid grasp of architectural patterns (MVC/MVVM/Clean ), DI , and state management (BLoC/Riverpod/Provider).
  • Hands-on with RESTful APIs , WebSockets/Streams , async/isolates , and robust error handling.
  • Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Analytics) or equivalent , Microsoft Clarity (for UX/session insights in web-embedded contexts), and Sentry for error/performance monitoring.
  • Git proficiency, code reviews, CI (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI ), and Jira work logs/time tracking .


Nice to Have

  • Deep macOS expertise: signing, notarization , App Sandbox , entitlements, Keychain, packaging, and updater pipelines.
  • Practical WebRTC experience; spatial audio; jitter/latency tuning.
  • Android/iOS publishing (fastlane or equivalent), push notifications, and in-app review flows.
  • Docker , CDN , and networking basics for real-time apps.
  • Accessibility (VoiceOver/TalkBack) and internationalization.


Benefits & Environment

  • Remote-first, flexible hours, and competitive market range .
  • Fast feedback loops, ownership, and a product with real impact on how teams work every day.
  • Support for learning, events, and continuous improvement.

title: Médico da Família e Comunidade (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO DE SAÚDE DA FAMÍLIA E COMUNIDADE (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Medicina e Saúde da Família e Comunidade! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você Realizará atendimento de orientação médica telefônica através de uma abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde relativos a diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Executar atividade de coordenação do cuidado, identificando situações com necessidade de encaminhamento à equipe de segunda opinião médica, comunicando-se eficientemente com os pacientes e sendo o interlocutor do caso ao gerente de segunda opinião médica.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO CONCLUÍDA EM MEDICINA DA FAMILIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em MEDICINA DA FAMILIA ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em MEDICINA DA FAMILIA, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose


The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.


⸻


Core Responsibilities


• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.


• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts .

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations , manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.


• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules .

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.


• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders , with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.


⸻


Key Qualifications


• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.


• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

• Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.

• Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
O Desafio


Procuramos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Inteligência Artificial Sênior apaixonado(a) por transformar dados em soluções escaláveis, com conhecimento consolidado em LLMs e IA. Você será fundamental para projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de IA de ponta, focados em Processamento de Linguagem Natural (PLN) para dados clínicos complexos.


Esperamos que você traga uma visão estratégica sobre IA e MLOps, ajudando a moldar a arquitetura dos nossos produtos e expandir nossos horizontes tecnológicos.


Em um ambiente colaborativo e de equipe enxuta, valorizamos a iniciativa e protagonismo : buscamos pessoas que se sintam confortáveis propondo, liderando e implementando soluções complexas, com um olhar atento à performance, escalabilidade e ética da IA.


Responsabilidades


Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de modelos de IA/LLMs: desde a pesquisa e prototipagem até a implementação em produção e monitoramento contínuo.


Projetar e construir arquiteturas de software escaláveis para hospedar e gerenciar LLMs e outros modelos de IA.


Implementar e otimizar pipelines de MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) para garantir a entrega contínua, deployment e monitoramento de modelos.


Desenvolver e otimizar estratégias de Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para LLMs, visando a extração precisa de informações clínicas e a geração de respostas contextuais.


Escrever códigos de forma limpa, escalável, performática e testável, aplicando os melhores padrões de engenharia de software.


Realizar revisões de código de pares, fornecendo feedback construtivo e garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas.


Analisar requerimentos de negócio e produto, transformando-os em especificações técnicas e priorizando tarefas de alto impacto.


Atuar como mentor(a) técnico(a) para desenvolvedores e engenheiros de IA mais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e promovendo o crescimento da equipe.


Colaborar ativamente com cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e especialistas de domínio (médicos) para garantir a relevância e eficácia das soluções de IA.


Manter-se atualizado(a) com as últimas pesquisas e avanços em IA, PLN e LLMs, e avaliar a aplicação de novas tecnologias.


Requisitos


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Software ou IA Sênior, com foco em sistemas de IA/ML em produção.


  • Proficiência avançada em Python e experiência com frameworks de ML/DL (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).


  • Conhecimento consolidado e experiência prática com Large Language Models (LLMs), incluindo técnicas (e.g., Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning, RAG) e ferramentas (e.g., Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex).


  • Experiência robusta no desenvolvimento e implantação de pipelines de MLOps e em plataformas de nuvem (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure ML).


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos (Docker, Kubernetes).


  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.


  • Capacidade de escrever e implementar rotinas de testes abrangentes para código e modelos de IA.


  • Habilidade de liderança técnica para projetos, decisões arquiteturais e mentoria de equipes.


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Conhecimentos Desejáveis


  • Fluência em inglês.


  • Experiência com C# e .NET (para integração).


  • Conhecimento de frameworks front-end (Angular, React) para interfaces de IA.


  • Experiência específica com dados de saúde (HL7, FHIR) ou no setor de healthtech.


  • Otimização de modelos para inferência em larga escala (e.g., com GPUs).


  • Conhecimento em ética em IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e viés em modelos.


Se você quer atuar no cruzamento entre tecnologia de ponta, IA, dados complexos e saúde - e gosta de resolver problemas que fazem a diferença na vida de milhares, impulsionando a próxima geração da medicina - se candidate e venha conversar conosco!

  • Interagir com stakeholders de alto nível (C-level, diretores, gerentes de tecnologia e negócios), traduzindo desafios estratégicos em soluções técnicas viáveis.

Os líderes da Deloitte vivem o nosso propósito: gerar impactos positivos. Energizam, empoderam, conectam, interagem, reagem e pensam de formas diferentes. Por isso, buscamos pessoas que são inspiradoras, criam ambientes diversos, influenciam uma cultura colaborativa e, com isso, entregam valor. Nossa liderança é peça-chave para o nosso crescimento.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.


O que precisa para você se candidatar à vaga?

- Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.

- Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica de projetos de inteligência artificial ou ciência de dados em consultoria ou grandes empresas.

- Conhecimento avançado em Python , frameworks de IA/ML (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face) e bibliotecas para NLP e CV.

- Domínio de arquiteturas de LLMs e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) , pipelines de MLOps e boas práticas de implantação em produção.

- Experiência em cloud computing (GCP, AWS ou Azure) e computação paralela.

- Forte habilidade de comunicação e capacidade de interagir com clientes de diferentes níveis de maturidade tecnológica.

-Inglês fluente.

O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento profissional

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role

Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure + Elixir + Linux)
description:
DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure • Elixir • Linux )


Who We Are Seeking:


We seek a talented and experienced DevOps/Distributed Systems Engineer to operate and harden our Elixir services and Hyperledger Besu node network on Microsoft Azure to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.


Your Role and Responsibilities:  


  • Run Besu on Azure: manage validators/peers, permissioning, bootnodes, IBFT/QBFT configs, genesis updates, hard-fork rollouts, and RPC/WS endpoints behind Azure gateways.
  • Storage & performance: size and tune Besu (JVM/RocksDB) with Premium SSD v2 / Ultra Disk, optimize IOPS/throughput, and implement snapshot/restore pipelines via Azure Blob Storage.
  • Networking: build secure, private networking with VNets, subnets, Azure CNI (Cilium), Network Security Groups, Private Endpoints/Private Link, NAT Gateway, and VNet peering/ExpressRoute as needed.
  • Traffic & ingress: expose RPC/WS endpoints through Azure Application Gateway or Nginx Ingress with Web Application Firewall (WAF), mTLS, rate limits, and IP allowlists.
  • Secrets & keys: manage validator keys and app secrets with Azure Key Vault / Managed HSM, Managed Identities, and least-privilege RBAC via Microsoft Entra ID.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: ship immutable releases using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, ACR (image signing/scan), Helm, and Argo CD (or Flux) for environment promotion.
  • Observability & SRE: wire up Azure Monitor + Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana (or self-managed Prometheus/Grafana), OpenTelemetry traces, Alert rules, runbooks, SLOs/error budgets.


Tech You’ll Use:


  • Blockchain: Hyperledger Besu (IBFT/QBFT, permissioning); Geth/Nethermind familiarity is a plus
  • Elixir: Elixir/OTP, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, OpenTelemetry
  • Azure: AKS, ACR, Azure Monitor & Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana, Key Vault / Managed HSM, Application Gateway/WAF, NAT Gateway, NSG, Private Link, Azure Firewall, Blob Storage, Managed Disks (Premium v2/Ultra), Azure Backup/Site Recovery, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Entra ID
  • IaC & CI/CD: Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
  • Logging/Tracing: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK (optional), OpenTelemetry


Essential Qualifications:  


  • 4+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform roles running distributed systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience operating EVM nodes (preferably Besu ) and tuning storage/IO, txpool, and pruning/archive modes.
  • Strong Azure background: AKS, VNet/NSG/Private Link, Key Vault, ACR, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, and Application Gateway/WAF.
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (TLS, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing).
  • Proven observability practice: metrics, logs, traces, actionable alerting, SLOs/runbooks.
  • Excellent written and spoken English (daily collaboration across teams).


Who We Are:


DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Position Summary :


JUMP Math is a Canadian-based registered charity and social enterprise with a bold mission to inspire a love of mathematics in students and help them achieve their full potential. Our evidence-based approach and innovative Preschool to Grade 9 resources and pedagogy empowers teachers and students to build confidence, increase engagement, and master essential math skills. At JUMP Math, we believe that everyone can succeed in math, and we are committed to making a lasting impact in classrooms across the globe. As an organization, we pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment where every team member is motivated by the shared goal of transforming math education.


As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a dynamic and skilled Lead Engineer with product and technology expertise and experience in project delivery to help lead our various technology and content digitization efforts. If you are passionate about making a real difference and want to contribute to a mission-driven organization that is changing the world, JUMP Math is the place for you.


As a Lead Engineer, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for building, reviewing, and maintaining the core systems of the JUMP Math platform. You will ensure that both our application and AI engine are robust, scalable, and maintainable. You will lead and collaborate closely with the engineering team, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and ensuring the team is aligned and effective. You will also work closely with Product and Design to drive the platform forward.


This is a full-time role (37.5 hours/week).


Location of Work: This candidate for this role must be residing in Brazil and is intended to be remote.


Key Accountabilities:

  • Own and deliver high-quality code across the full stack (frontend, backend, and AI integration)
  • Lead and mentor a development team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment
  • Conduct code reviews and maintain coding standards to ensure maintainability and reliability
  • Manage DevOps tasks including deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and scaling
  • Design and implement APIs, and integrate with third-party services
  • Ensure security, performance, and reliability of the platform in production environments
  • Troubleshoot and resolve critical technical issues across the stack and optimize code
  • Participate in architecture decisions and recommend improvements to the platform design
  • Collaborate with the Machine Learning team to integrate AI question generation and scaffolding into the platform
  • Contribute to defining accessibility standards and compliance (data protection, privacy, and security in educational environments)
  • Coordinate with distributed teams across different time zones, ensuring clear and efficient communication


Skills:

  • Skilled in code review, system architecture, and software best practices
  • Proficiency in backend languages and frontend frameworks
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, leadership and collaboration skills
  • High level of Spanish and English
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Familiarity with Generative AI (Chat GPT, Prompting, APIs, Fine-tuning) and Machine Learning algorithms (Python)


Personal Attributes:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Proactive and adaptable to a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Commitment to social mission and inclusive education


Education and Experience (minimums):

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with full-stack development
  • Strong experience in DevOps / cloud infrastructure (AWS, CI/CD pipelines)
  • Experience in projects using PHP (Laravel), React.JS, Next.JS
  • Knowledge of data security and regulatory compliance (GDPR, FERPA, or other relevant frameworks)
  • Experience with databases (eg. MySQL, MariaDB, Supabase, MongoDB), caching, and API design
  • Experience integrating AI/ML models into production applications
  • Experience leading distributed or remote teams
  • Basic knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive UX practices


To Apply :

Please use the cover letter to explain in one page how your qualifications match our requirements and why this job is right for you at this point in your career.

JUMP Math is committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from racialized persons/persons of colour, women, Indigenous/Aboriginal people of North America, persons with disabilities, LGBTQ persons, and others who may contribute to further diversification of ideas. title: Professor de inglês
description:

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.

  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).

  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: HR Operation Senior Specialist
description:
【Responsibilities】

1. HR Policy Enablement & Governance：

Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.

Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.

Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.


2. HR Process Standardization & Optimization:

Design, document, and continuously improve HR processes to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are well-integrated and operationally sound.

Establish clear workflows and guidelines for employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, probation and internal mobility, etc..


3. Quality Controal & Employee Experience：

- Ensure seamless execution of HR policies to improve employee experience and operational efficiency.

- Provide training and communication on policy updates and process changes to HR teams and managers.

- Conduct periodic audits to verify adherence to HR policies and recommend corrective actions where needed.

- Implement a quality audit framework to regularly assess HR operations, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.


【Requirements】

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.

- 5+ years of experience in HR operations, policy management, or process governance within an international organization.

- Strong knowledge of HR policy frameworks, compliance, and global employment regulations.

- Experience in developing and implementing HR SOPs and process documentation.

- Proficiency in HR technology solutions and data-driven decision-making.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


【Highlights】

- Be a driver in creating HR policies in a rapidly growing global company.

- Influence decision-making by implementing scalable HR frameworks that will define future operations.

- Work with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies to develop global HR policies while ensuring local compliance.

- Gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of international HR operations in a fast-scaling business.

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality audits to enhance HR service delivery.

title: Senior IT Technical Recruiter – LATAM Based
description:
Aptonet Inc. is seeking experienced Senior IT Technical Recruiters to join our world-class recruiting team. This role is based in Latin America (LATAM) and will focus on sourcing, screening, and placing top technical talent. You will recruit LATAM-based candidates for U.S.-based companies and also support U.S.-based recruiting efforts for our U.S. clients.

Our recruiting team builds the foundation of our clients’ success by connecting them with extraordinary talent who share our vision and values.


What We Look For

  • 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in an agency setting or a high-growth tech environment .
  • Proven experience recruiting for diverse Information Technology roles .
  • Understanding of technology trends and a passion for working with technical professionals.
  • Strong ability to multi-task , manage multiple roles, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal – in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and customer service focus.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook , and modern ATS systems.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process , including sourcing, screening, interviews, feedback, offers, and onboarding.
  • Build strong pipelines of both LATAM and U.S.-based technical candidates using creative sourcing strategies.
  • Leverage a variety of sourcing tools, including internet research, Boolean search strings, LinkedIn, ATS mining, and cold calling .
  • Evaluate applicants by comparing qualifications to job requirements and conducting initial screening interviews.
  • Post job advertisements across relevant platforms such as LinkedIn, Dice, CareerBuilder , and niche tech sites.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers and internal teams to understand role requirements and deliver top candidates quickly.
  • Maintain data accuracy in the ATS and track recruiting metrics for reporting and continuous improvement.
  • Develop scalable recruiting processes to support the growth of our recruiting operations in LATAM and the U.S.
  • Act as a trusted representative of Aptonet , promoting our values and delivering a high-quality experience to both candidates and clients.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.



WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base



REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.



WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability



READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.



Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Digital Care 2 You- Aplicação de Inteligência Artificial na Jornada do paciente | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI and full-stack engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. Ready for Your Next Career Move?

Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

title: Physics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Job Title:

Physics Subject Matter Expert – AI Training & Content Development


About Innodata:

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a global leader in data engineering and AI-powered solutions , working with 4 of the top 5 global technology companies and over 2,000 enterprise clients worldwide . Operating in 13 global locations with a workforce of 5,000+ subject matter experts , Innodata leads innovation in machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and large language model (LLM) training.


By combining cutting-edge AI technology, deep domain expertise, and secure infrastructure , Innodata delivers transformative solutions that power the next generation of intelligent systems.


About the Role:

We are seeking a Physics Subject Matter Expert (SME) with exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and writing skills to join our AI/LLM training team .

You will play a crucial role in developing, curating, and evaluating advanced physics content to enhance AI models’ reasoning, accuracy, and ability to explain complex physics concepts.

This role is ideal for physicists, researchers, and academics passionate about science communication and AI innovation.


Key Responsibilities:

Content Development:

  • Create high-quality physics datasets , including:
  • Conceptual explanations of physics principles (classical, quantum, and modern physics).
  • Problem sets and numerical solutions.
  • Detailed derivations of equations and laws.
  • Technical summaries and scientific research briefs.
  • Build domain-specific datasets across physics subfields such as:
  • Mechanics, Thermodynamics, and Electromagnetism
  • Quantum Mechanics, Particle Physics, and Nuclear Physics
  • Astrophysics, Relativity, and Cosmology
  • Materials Science and Condensed Matter Physics
  • Computational Physics and Applied Physics


Model Evaluation & AI Training:

  • Evaluate LLM-generated physics content for accuracy, clarity, rigor, and logical reasoning.
  • Detect and correct conceptual gaps, numerical errors, and inconsistencies in AI outputs.
  • Help define data quality standards and evaluation rubrics for scientific reasoning.

Collaboration & R&D:

  • Work closely with AI engineers, computational linguists, and data scientists to improve AI reasoning.
  • Provide domain expertise for designing AI benchmarks and test scenarios.
  • Contribute to research on physics education, simulation modeling, and AI-assisted scientific research.


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s or PhD in Physics, Applied Physics, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline (PhD preferred).
  • Strong foundation in theoretical and applied physics .
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more areas:
  • Computational modeling, simulations, or numerical methods.
  • Advanced topics (e.g., quantum field theory, condensed matter, astrophysics).
  • Proven experience in academic publishing, science communication, or curriculum design .
  • Strong technical writing skills and ability to explain complex concepts clearly .


Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with AI/ML models, data annotation, and prompt engineering (bonus).
  • Experience in LaTeX, Python, or scientific computing tools .
  • Knowledge of AI fairness and bias detection in STEM datasets.


Why Join Innodata?

  • Shape the future of AI by embedding physics expertise into large-scale models.
  • Collaborate with top-tier researchers and engineers globally.
  • Influence next-gen AI capabilities in scientific reasoning.
  • Work remotely with flexibility and innovation-driven teams .


Additional Information:

  • Candidates must complete an English Language Assessment .
  • Mandatory and non-billable step.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (React/Golang)
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply. Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We’re looking for a driven, resourceful, and experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join one of our growing product teams. As a senior member of the team, you will be tasked with designing, building, and enhancing services and user-facing features across our platform, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, scalability, and user experience. You’ll leverage your expertise spanning the entire stack, from database interactions to front-end libraries, contributing significantly to our technical direction and mentoring other engineers.


How you will make an impact

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable full-stack applications and features across a modern tech stack, including Typescript, React, Go and Postgres.
  • Focus on improving our user experience, collaborating with designers to implement intuitive interfaces and finding creative ways to reduce user pain points.
  • Build and enhance microservices, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and scalability within our distributed systems.
  • Ensure the quality of our products remains high by contributing to automated testing strategies and participating actively in code reviews.
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, QA analysts, and other engineers within an Agile development framework.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, identifying and driving improvements in our processes, architecture, and technology stack.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a collaborative environment and sharing your expertise.
  • Distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements and robust technical designs.


You may be a good fit for this role if you

  • Are passionate about coding and creating scalable systems and fantastic user experiences.
  • Embrace a growth mindset by continuously questioning established ideas and learning from your experiences.
  • Exhibit humility and a collaborative spirit, fostering a positive work environment while valuing the contributions of others without ego.
  • Value autonomy and empowerment to make your own decisions.


What you will do

During the 1st Month:

  • Attend onboarding sessions to better understand our internal processes and learn about the company
  • Pair with other engineers to learn more about our tech stack, the products we support, and our development standards and processes
  • Familiarize yourself with our automated testing platforms and begin to contribute to our test coverage
  • Collaborate with product team members to implement and ship small features and functionality

Within 3 Months:

  • Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to other engineers
  • Gain exposure to the platform’s underlying infrastructure and deployment processes
  • Understand the high-level architecture of the website and back-end services
  • Begin shipping more complex user-facing code

Within 6 Months:

  • Grow as a contributing member of a product team, providing input and insight to the rest of the team on challenges and feasibility of proposed development
  • Confidently implement new functionality and fix bugs across our stack
  • Work with members of the tech and product teams to distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements/design

Within 12 months:

  • Begin identifying areas for improvement in our codebase, researching best practices, and making recommendations to the team on strategies to address them
  • Solidify understanding of the breadth of our tech stack, including underlying infrastructure, internal tools, front end applications, and how they interact with our back-end services
  • Be a subject matter expert for the product team’s areas of responsibility


What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Experience with Typescript and React
  • Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages (Go, C/C++, C#, Java, Ruby, etc.)
  • Experience with one or more SQL databases
  • Strong understanding of common data structures and design patterns
  • Experience working with a microservice architecture and distributed systems
  • Proficiency in using unit testing frameworks
  • A dedication to developing clear, reliable, and maintainable code
  • Proficiency with common git operations
  • Strong communication skills, effectively conveying ideas to both technical and non-technical partners
  • Experience mentoring other engineers

Conhecimento em frameworks como Ktor ou Spring Boot com Kotlin. Boas práticas de programação funcional e orientada a objetos em Kotlin. - Uso de coroutines para programação assíncrona. - Testes automatizados com JUnit, MockK ou Kotest. Java + Spring Boot. Experiência com Spring Boot e seus módulos (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). - Uso de JPA/Hibernate para persistência de dados. - Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e GraphQL. - Testes com JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers. Python. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário para **scripts, automação e integração**. - Experiência com frameworks como **FastAPI ou Flask** é um diferencial. - Manipulação de dados com **Pandas e NumPy** (caso necessário). **AWS (Cloud)** - Experiência com **AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway e IAM**. - Infraestrutura como código (**Terraform, AWS CDK ou CloudFormation**). - Monitoramento e logging com **CloudWatch**. - Conhecimento em **ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes** é um diferencial. **Outros Conhecimentos Desejáveis** - Experiência com **CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)**. - Banco de dados **SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)**. - Mensageria com **Kafka ou RabbitMQ**. - Containers e Docker. - Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Principais Responsabilidades do Desenvolvedor 1. Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento Backend Criar e manter microsserviços escaláveis usando Kotlin (Spring Boot). Projetar e desenvolver APIs REST e GraphQL. Implementar boas práticas de clean code, design patterns e SOLID. Gerenciar persistência de dados utilizando PostgreSQL, DynamoDB ou MongoDB. 2. Integração com AWS e Infraestrutura Desenvolver e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway e RDS. Criar pipelines de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK). Implementar monitoramento e logging com AWS CloudWatch e Prometheus. 3. Processamento e Automação de Dados Construir pipelines de processamento de dados com Kafka ou AWS Kinesis. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;

description:

Sobre a CBO:

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Descrição detalhada:

1. Assegurar que os serviços de dados das embarcações estejam funcionando plenamente, através de manutenção dos serviços de dados de forma proativa por meio de monitoramento e atendimento a chamados abertos na ferramenta de helpdesk;

7. Analisar multas e downtimes, através de analise dos eventos de TI que causaram perda de receita com a finalidade de mitigar novos eventos similares;


8. Garantir a disseminação do conhecimento das tecnologias das embarcações (VSAT, TVRO, Antenas estabilizadas, CFTV, etc). Dividir conhecimento com a equipe de TI Operações de modo a aumentar a senioridade do corpo técnico, garantindo maior assertividade nos atendimentos;

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Company Description

Yuna's mission is to radically transform the way mental health support is accessed and delivered. By providing 24/7 instant and private support at the push of a button, we aim to address the significant gaps in mental health care accessibility. In a system where waiting times for therapists can reach up to 48 days and many people can't even afford care, Yuna is the answer to immediate mental health support needs.

We’re growing quickly, and every person who joins us plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of mental health technology.


Position Overview

You’ll be the backbone behind Yuna’s conversational stack—owning services, data, and runtime that make our AI safe, fast, and reliable at scale. You’ll partner with the Staff ML Engineer to turn models into resilient, observable, HIPAA-aware product experiences.


What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and operate services for conversation state, user memory, retrieval, and tool integrations (REST/gRPC).
  • Work closely with clinical psychologists (both internal and external to Yuna), ensuring the efficacy of Yuna’s conversational AI
  • Collaborate with front end teams for API creation, QA, and implementation
  • Implement alignment & safety layers (e.g., self-harm detection, red-teaming, refusal strategies, escalation paths) tuned to clinical guidelines
  • Optimize for latency, cost, and quality
  • Partner tightly with product, sales, and users to scope new features and


What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years building backend systems in production (Go/Python/NodeJS), with strong systems and API design skills
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, RAG pipelines, and LLMs
  • Cloud infrastructure expertise (Google Cloud Platform)
  • Proficiency with relational + vector/search systems and real-time communication (sockets, WebRTC)
  • Nice to have: Swift (iOS client integration)
  • Strong product sense; you care about user outcomes, not just model metrics
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and creating systems 0 to 1


Location: Remote (work from anywhere, with at least 6 hours overlap with PST)

Employment Type: Full Time


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (based on experience) + equity options
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility
  • A fast-growing, talented, and empathetic team dedicated to transforming mental health care
  • The opportunity to make a real-world impact, building cutting-edge AI systems and real-time communication platforms that improve lives every day

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Analista de Negócios

Estamos procurando um Gestor de Lojas para integrar o nosso Departamento de Gestão de Lojas. Essa pessoa será responsável por administrar de forma completa 2 a 3 lojas de marketplace de franqueados, garantindo performance, organização e transparência com o investidor da loja.


SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES:


-Gerenciamento de anúncios (preço, descrição, promoções, publicidade, etc.).

-Comunicação rotineira com o franqueado investidor, entregando relatórios de performance (anúncios, estoque, financeiro).


-Criação de ferramentas e automações. Buscando tornar sua rotina cada vez mais eficiênte.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


-Visão de negócios e senso de dono: olhar além da execução, buscando sempre melhorar a performance da loja.


-Organização e disciplina para lidar com múltiplas demandas.


-Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, para interações com logística, fornecedores e franqueados.


-Raciocínio analítico para interpretar dados e criar relatórios úteis.


-Resolução de problemas com proatividade e agilidade.


-Gestão de tempo para dividir a atenção entre diferentes lojas e diferentes tarefas.


-Excel/planilhas em nível intermediário.


-Inglês funcional.


-Abertura para aprender muito, já que todo nosso modelo será ensinado internamente.


DIFERENCIAIS COMPETITIVOS:


-Alta capacidade lógica e analítica (logic-driven thinking).


-Excel avançado (fórmulas avançadas, VBA, dashboards).


-Uso eficaz de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial.


-Experiência prévia em e-commerce/marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee).


-Conhecimento em programação (Python é um plus).


-Experiência com bancos de dados (SQL) e APIs.


-Experiência em finanças empresariais (fluxo de caixa, margem de contribuição, indicadores).

title: Executive Operations Integrator
description:
Role: Executive Operations Integrator (Beauty Industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics: We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry/salon space.

Contract: Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate: $2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start: Immediately


Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.


What You'll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:


Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.


Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.


Who You Are

São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

  1. Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente Administrativo para atuar no suporte ao time de Manutenção Industrial, com foco na gestão de dados técnicos e atividades administrativas rotineiras. title: Assistente de customer happiness temporário (atendimento ao cliente)
description:
A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona.

Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Customer Happiness temporário (Atendimento ao Cliente) e a missão dessa posição é de ajudar nossos clientes, resolver as demandas, garantindo uma solução eficaz e um atendimento de excelência.

Requisitos e qualificações:

title: Recepcionista - afirmativa pcd i rio de janeiro
description:
Sobre a OceanPact

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.

Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) Recepcionista - Afirmativa PcD para atuar em nossa Companhia.

O perfil ideal deve compartilhar de nossos valores e expressar compromisso em obter os melhores resultados, além de gostar do que faz e não medir esforços para exercer suas atividades com segurança.

Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde a criatividade e a inovação fazem parte do dia a dia, essa oportunidade é para você!

Responsabilidades 
  • Recepcionar visitantes, clientes e fornecedores;
  • Atender ligações e direcionar para os setores certos;
  • Apoiar em tarefas administrativas (cópias, digitalização, correspondências etc.);
  • Organizar arquivos físicos e digitais;
  • Registrar e controlar pedidos de manutenção e serviços;
  • Preencher planilhas simples (visitantes, salas, materiais);
  • Lançar dados básicos em sistemas internos.
Requisitos 
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento básico em Pacote Office (especialmente Excel e Word);
  • Boa comunicação, organização e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Facilidade para lidar com diferentes tarefas e ambientes de trabalho.
Local de trabalho
  • Glória - Rio de Janeiro
  • Modalide: Presencial
O que buscamos

Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:

  • Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade

  • O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência

  • Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento

  • Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas

  • Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias

  • Resultados: foco em entregas com valor

O que oferecemos

  • Pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, com salário fixo e benefícios competitivos

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico, para você e sua família, porque cuidar de quem cuida importa

  • Vale-refeição e/ou alimentação, além de vale-transporte (ou auxílio mobilidade, conforme o modelo de trabalho)

  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, seguro e ético, onde o cuidado com as pessoas e o mar são levados a sério

  • Oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento profissional, com participação em projetos relevantes, treinamentos e contato com equipes multidisciplinares

  • Cultura forte e propósito claro, em uma empresa brasileira sólida, que cresce com responsabilidade e inovação

  • Estabilidade e confiança, em uma organização que atua com excelência e compromisso no setor marítimo e offshore

title: Nutricionista / Comissário
description:
Estamos em busca de um Nutricionista Comissário para integrar nossa equipe. Este profissional será responsável pela gestão de toda a área de hotelaria marítima a bordo, incluindo serviços de alimentação (catering), segurança dos alimentos, saúde, higiene, housekeeping e controle de custos.
